buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic

Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 6. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 2/3rd Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 2/3rd usable shelf life should be available / balance. 7. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document.

11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. Clause-wise Compliance: The bidders shall upload clause-wise compliance with all applicable terms a nd conditions of the RFP along with supporting documents. Separate compliance sheets shall be submitted for Part III, Part IV and Part V of the RFP. 2. Drug / Manufacturing Licence: The bidders shall upload a valid Drug Licence, Manufacturing Licence or Import Licence of the concerned OEM or authorised importer, as applicable to the offered products. 3. OEM Authorisation and Turnover: The bidders shall upload a valid bid-specific OEM Authorisation Ce rtificate along with the OEM's audited turnover certificate for the latest financial years, wherever applicabl e as per bid conditions and GeM provisions. 4. Authenticity of Documents: The bidders shall upload a separate self-declaration on their official lett erhead confirming that all uploaded documents are genuine and valid. Submission of false or forged docu ments may lead to rejection of the bid and further action as per applicable rules. 5. HSN Code: The bidders shall mention the correct HSN code and applicable GST rate of the offered prod ucts wherever required. Any discrepancy or omission shall be dealt with as per applicable GeM provisions. 6. Repeat Order Certificate: The bidders shall upload an undertaking confirming willingness to supply a dditional quantities up to 50 percent of the original contracted quantity at the same rates and terms, subje ct to Para 6.35.2 of DPM 2025 and applicable Repeat Order conditions. 7. Non-Blacklisting, Financial Standing and EMD Exemption: The bidders shall upload separate Non -Blacklisting and Financial Standing Certificates. Bidders claiming EMD exemption shall upload valid suppo rting documents as per applicable GeM rules. 8. Single Consignment Delivery: The bidders shall upload an undertaking confirming supply of the entir e contracted quantity in a single consignment within the stipulated delivery period. Part delivery shall not be accepted unless authorised by the Buyer. 9. Technical Compliance Sheet: The bidders shall upload a separate compliance sheet against all techn ical specifications mentioned on pages 07 to 09 of the RFP, HD Photographs along with original packaging of the product and its relevant supporting documents. 10. Compliance with Para 19: The bidders shall upload a separate clause-wise compliance sheet coveri ng Para 19 and all its sub-paragraphs of the RFP, along with supporting documents wherever required. 11. GMP / GLP Certificate: The bidders shall upload valid GMP / GLP certificates wherever applicable an d required for the offered products. 12. Make in India Declaration: The bidders shall upload a Make in India local content declaration along with the percentage and breakdown of local content, as required under the latest applicable DPIIT guidelin es. Any false or incorrect declaration shall be dealt with as per applicable rules. 13. Uploading of Bid Documents: The bidders shall upload documents separately under the relevant c ategories on GeM. Clubbing of unrelated documents should be avoided for easy verification during technic al evaluation. 14. GFR Rule 144(xi) Compliance: The bidders shall upload a duly signed declaration confirming compli ance with GFR Rule 144(xi) and applicable Department of Expenditure orders, including valid registration w ith the Competent Authority wherever required. .
